topic: Implementing new KPI metrics for Latvia
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the implementation timeline for new Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) in Latvia. The required metrics include average traffic per day, average traffic per week, and segmented average traffic across six specific daily time intervals (e.g., 08:01–12:00). It was determined that a rough prototype could be deployed within one day, with further refinement of the visualization boxes to follow.
decisions: A prototype for the new KPI metrics can be launched within one day.
action_items: [me] needs to refine the dashboard visualizations (boxes) after the initial prototype deployment.
